annotations.title: Vault depositors: balances, flows and estimated results

description: Depositors in vaults: how many positions carry a verified or an estimated result and why the rest do not (coverage, per status), the vaults where the median depositor did best and worst, where profit came fastest (median return per day over positions closed in profit), and the addresses that made and lost the most, with who they are where a source names them. Result = position now + withdrawn − deposited since the first flow we read; verified = share ledger read, estimated = flows only, never mixed. Quote nCalculated of nObserved with any figure. Boards rank only vaults whose results cover 10+ positions and 5%+ of those observed; an address is not a person. FREE.

basis.description: Pin the result basis of the boards and address lists to verified or estimated. Left out: each vault on verified once 10+ verified positions clear the coverage gate, else on its estimate, every row naming its basis.

limit.description: Rows per list, default 20, at most 300.

name: vault_user_results

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

best.description: Highest median observed result, eligible positions; each row with coverage and asset type.

combinedResult.description: Combined result of positions with enough history: usd (null when withheld), status, published, withheldBecause.

coverage.description: Positions with a result (calculated) of positions observed, the share, and the sentence to quote with any figure.

coverageGate.description: The minimum results and share of positions a vault needs to be ranked.

fastest.description: Highest median daily return among profitable closed positions (not an APY).

historyReadBack.description: Since 2026-11-25: how much of the capital (ageShareUsd, resultShareUsd) and of the observed pairs (ageSharePositions, resultSharePositions) has its depositors read back to each vault’s deployment, by state, with its time (at) and the sentence (says). Results can only become known inside the read-back part.

means.description: What the figures are and what they leave out.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

noResultReasons.description: Why positions have no result, in words, with counts.

totals.description: Addresses, positions, in profit, at a loss, open, unknown, summed result.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

worst.description: Lowest median USD result among measured positions.

title: Vault depositors: balances, flows and estimated results
